issue: The frozen runner labeled its resident-aware preparation estimate as current_simple_threshold. The preserved workload-v0.1 method mechanism_aware_local_incremental_cost did not read per-event resident state or target-model readiness for discrimination; target-model preparation was a common term in restart and recovery.
effect_on_results: The native branch and all recorded outcomes for the current simple threshold remain action-equivalent and numerically unchanged. The frozen decision_record is not faithful evidence of the preserved method's information usage and must be read together with this correction.
claim_boundary: This correction does not turn the online threshold into a resident-aware method. The proposed eviction-externality-aware rule remains a future design requiring a separately frozen validation.
